cases.name: Brooke McLaughlin
cases.about:
She was going into 8th-grade at Maranacook Middle School.

She is remembered as being a 'kind, loving, very thoughtful, big hearted, strong person who lived her family and friends,' according to her obituary.
cases.narrative: On 7/17/2022, her mother found her dead in their home.
